description: Win probability for the side batting first in a men's T20, while the total is being set. On 106 men's T20 internationals played after all its training data (1 Jul to 17 Sep 2026): AUC 0.912 with both team names and the ground, 0.888 with the ground only. Per call.

balls_bowled.description: Legal balls bowled, as a scorecard counts them: 1-120, and 12.3 overs = 75.

chasing_team.description: The team bowling first, by name. Team strength is used only when both are known.

setting_team.description: The team batting first, by name (e.g. "India"). Used with chasing_team.

venue.description: The ground's name as scorecards write it.

name: hsh-cricket-first-winprob
